verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills packages instructions and scripts that Claude loads and runs through Claude Code and the Claude API, so whether user data is used for model training is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers training opt-outs, data-retention controls or a no-training policy. The privacy-adjacent items (private workspace skill availability, disabling bundled skills, admin MCP restrictions) control access and features, not training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
